correctness.rationale: Writing the family Q²+qR=0, base change q=s² and blow up (s,Q) yields strict-transform chart Q=sw,w²+R=0 and a smooth double cover of Q=0. Parametrizing the conic gives R|Q=-(U⁸+14U⁴V⁴+V⁸), with discriminant 2^40 3^4, so branch is squarefree in characteristic ≠2,3 and fiber genus three. Deck involution s→−s sends w→−w, the hyperelliptic involution; hence inertia on H¹ is −Id, ruling out odd ramification good reduction and proving e_min=2. Independently checked all polynomial identities and discriminant; the geometric smooth/proper and inertia steps are mathematical, not computation.
